title: Listening Drill — Building a rain gauge — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Building a rain gauge — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on building a rain gauge last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with tilted base. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: cracked stand.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of rim level so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow plastic bottle instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the lab assistant before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
